parameters.content:
## Missed-Call Text-Back (template)
Test mode is ON by default (data/config.json -> defaults.test_mode). In test mode nothing is sent: would-be texts go to data/logs/outbox.jsonl, owner alerts to data/logs/owner-alerts.jsonl.

Live sends need: a client number with A2P 10DLC registration, a provider credential, test_mode=false, provider=twilio|telnyx, and the matching send node enabled.

See README.md.
